title: Drill 6: Cannulation - Training ID 4
description: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Cannulation
objectives: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Cannulation
The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication for Intravenous and Intraosseous Cannulation procedure.
Discuss basic relevant anatomy involved in Intravenous and Intraosseous Cannulation.
Principles of intravenous and intraosseous cannulation.
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure.
Discuss and demonstrate Intravenous and Intraosseous Cannulation techniques.
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.
